needs_manual_review_reason: FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10): Publication found and linked via citation-chain search (was previously unlinked with no PMID). PMID 41999202, 'Incidental meningiomas have favorable clinical outcomes across molecular classification systems' (Neuro-oncology, 2026), matches exactly on authorship (Nguyen MP first author, Raleigh DR last author, the record's only two contributors) and topic (incidental meningioma molecular risk stratification); confirmed not retracted/corrected via Europe PMC. Also added related_accessions GSE293815 and GSE293981: live GSE293851 declares itself a SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE293981 ('The molecular architecture of incidental meningiomas'), which also contains a sibling SubSeries GSE293815 (targeted gene expression profiling by array) on the presumably same incidental-meningioma cohort -- GSE293815 does not yet have its own record anywhere in this inventory; this is a coverage gap worth harvesting in a future pass, not something resolved here. Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10 verification pass): date_deposited/date_updated filled in from the live GEO record's Series_submission_date/Series_last_update_date, previously 'Not reported'. PER-SAMPLE DATA RECOVERED (2026-07-11 fact-check pass): downloaded the full family.soft data for this series (all 131 GSM records) and parsed per-sample characteristics, not previously done. Each sample carries 'tissue', 'Sex', 'tumor grade', 'age at surgery', and 'outcome'. tumor grade: grade 1 (114), grade 2 (16), 1 sample 'n/a' (grade_breakdown filled in as 114/16/0, previously null/null/null; tags.grade_comparable corrected false to true). Sex: 105 female, 26 male (sex_distribution filled in, previously 'Not reported'). age at surgery: present for all 131 samples, range 20-87, median 59, matching the paper's own stated 'median age at detection of 59 years' (age_distribution filled in). outcome: 'censored' (125 samples) vs. 'progression' (6 samples) -- a genuine per-sample time-to-event/progression-free-survival field, so has_outcome_data corrected from 'Not reported' to true (and tags.has_outcome_data to true) per the schema definition. tissue_preservation left as 'Not reported': the per-sample 'tissue' field here just says 'meningioma' with no preservation method stated (unlike the sibling GSE292325/292326 methylation records, which have an explicit 'tissue type: FFPE' field), so this was not guessed.
